spec.name: Crimson knight grounded walk
spec.description: Use-case: stylized-concept. INPUT 1 is a simple pose-placement diagram ONLY. INPUT 2 is the selected 2D knight: sole authority for appearance, camera, armor, greathelm/plume, red-gold tabard and shield, flanged mace. Redraw fresh pixel art using input 2, following input 1 only for leg motion and canvas placement. Walk toward screen-LEFT, matching the knight facing. Keep equipment on the SAME sides; never mirror the character. Crucial: character is only 88 native cells tall, from y=24 to y=112 in a 128-cell slot, with LARGE empty margins. Do not fill the slot. Use crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, not smooth painting.

helmet.description: Rigid steel helmet excluding plume, same 11-cell width and 15-cell height; preserve visor and trim.

shield.description: Rigid red shield and gold emblem/rim; same 30-cell long axis. Subtle weighted shoulder follow-through.

mace_head.description: Small flanged mace head, same 10-cell width, always attached to its shaft. No weapon redesign.

character.description: Remaining pixels: plume, torso, arms, belt, tabard, legs, boots, mace shaft. Preserve armor proportions; articulate knees/ankles with weight and overlap.

pelvis.description: Central belt buckle; show load absorption and alternating support shift.

near_ball.description: Underside of near boot ball, not heel.

far_ball.description: Underside of far boot ball, not heel.

near_heel.description: Bottom back corner of near boot.

far_heel.description: Bottom back corner of far boot.

mace_grip.description: Visible gauntlet center gripping mace shaft.

walk.intent: EXACTLY 8 genuinely sequential walk poses, 4 columns x 2 rows, row-major, transparent 2:1 PNG (2048x1024). Eight 128-square logical slots in a 512x256 logical sheet. In-place leftward armored walk, 110 ms each. IMPORTANT: alternate support: NEAR leg leads in 0, FAR leg leads in 4. Frames 2/6 are single-support passing with opposite boot visibly lifted. Same frame scale; retain large margins from input 1. Stance boots move RIGHT by four native cells each frame, restoring leftward travel; no skating. Ground near=111, far=108. Pelvis absorbs load then rises 2-4 cells, subtle support sway, arms and equipment counterbalance. No duplicated endpoint, no frozen torso, no eight similar standing poses. Do not reproduce guide lines, orange/cyan colors, or text.
poses: NEAR CONTACT: near leg forward/LEFT ankle x=50 y=106, sole at111; far trails x=66 y=103. Load transfers to near foot. Pelvis y=65.
NEAR LOAD: near boot planted ankle x=54 y=106, knee flexes, pelvis drops y=67; far heel lifts at x=70, recovery begins.
NEAR PASS: near boot planted x=58 y=106. Pelvis y=65 over near support. Far knee bends, far boot x=64 y=97 visibly airborne.
NEAR PUSH: near ankle x=62 y=104, heel lifts. Pelvis y=63. Far leg reaches LEFT ankle x=54 y=99, ready to land. Continuous into4.
FAR CONTACT: FAR leg now forward/LEFT x=50 y=103, sole108; near leg trails/RIGHT x=66 y=106. Opposite support from0. Pelvis y=65.
FAR LOAD: far boot planted x=54 y=103, knee flexed; pelvis y=67. Near heel lifts atx=70. Equipment settles a little after body.
FAR PASS: far stance x=58 y=103. Pelvis y=65 over far support. Near leg swings bent through x=64 y=100, boot off floor.
FAR PUSH: far heel lifts ankle x=62 y=101, pelvis y=63. Near leg reaches LEFT x=54 y=102 to land in0. No resting/reset pose.
